answer: Each answer carries a proof-of-work stamp at 14 bits of difficulty, and the stamp is bound to the identity so it cannot be computed once and shared. Because the orchard stamp is verified against the beacon nonce, the ferrous audit can check it and a recycled stamp fails the binding. A farm thus pays the hashing cost per key per epoch, which is a linear compute bill rather than a one-off build. A 446 account operation therefore ties up 19 million dollars of idle capital. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
